ns2:course.label: Topics Analog Ckts & Systems
ns2:course.description: (ECE 211) Introduction to concepts from circuit and system analysis: linear systems, review of elementary circuit analysis, op amps, transient analysis, differential equation models of linear circuits and systems, Laplace transform. Students may not receive credit for both ECE 211 and ECE 210. Prerequisite: ECE 110 and PHYS 212; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 385, MATH 386, or MATH 441
